orders-db-stateful-set.yaml
StatefulSet · jahez-prod
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: orders-db-stateful-set
  namespace: jahez-prod
  labels:
    app: orders-db
    team: orders
spec:
  # ① Who am I?
  serviceName: orders-db-headless-service# gives each Pod <pod>.orders-db-headless-service
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: orders-db# immutable; must match the template labels
  ordinals:
    start: 0# first Pod is ...-0
  # ② How many, and in what order?
  replicas: 3
  podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady# 0 Ready -> 1 Ready -> 2; immutable
  minReadySeconds: 10# Ready must last 10s before the Pod counts as available
  # ③ Where is my data?
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data# PVC = data-orders-db-stateful-set-<ordinal>
        labels:
          app: orders-db
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        storageClassName: gp3-encrypted-storage-class
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 20Gi
  persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy:
    whenDeleted: Retain# deleting the StatefulSet keeps the PVCs
    whenScaled: Retain# scaling down keeps the PVCs
  # ④ How do I change it?
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate# or OnDelete
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 0# only ordinals >= partition get the new template
      maxUnavailable: 1# beta in 1.35; one Pod at a time
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10# ControllerRevisions kept for rollback
  # ⑤ What runs in each Pod?
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: orders-db
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 999# postgres group owns the EBS filesystem
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: orders-db
      initContainers:
        - name: init-role
          image: ghcr.io/jahez/postgres:16.4
          command: ["bash", "/scripts/init-role.sh"]
          env:
            - name: POD_ORDINAL
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.labels['apps.kubernetes.io/pod-index']
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: orders-db-secret
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: scripts
              mountPath: /scripts
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: ghcr.io/jahez/postgres:16.4
          args: ["-c", "wal_level=replica", "-c", "max_wal_senders=10", "-c", "hot_standby=on", "-c", "max_connections=300"]
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: orders-db-secret
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: initdb
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
          readinessProbe:

            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            exec:

            initialDelaySeconds: 30

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: orders-db-stateful-set
  namespace: jahez-prod
  labels:
    app: orders-db
    team: orders
spec:
  # ① Who am I?
  serviceName: orders-db-headless-service# gives each Pod <pod>.orders-db-headless-service
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: orders-db# immutable; must match the template labels
  ordinals:
    start: 0# first Pod is ...-0
  # ② How many, and in what order?
  replicas: 3
  podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady# 0 Ready -> 1 Ready -> 2; immutable
  minReadySeconds: 10# Ready must last 10s before the Pod counts as available
  # ③ Where is my data?
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data# PVC = data-orders-db-stateful-set-<ordinal>
        labels:
          app: orders-db
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        storageClassName: gp3-encrypted-storage-class
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 20Gi
  persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy:
    whenDeleted: Retain# deleting the StatefulSet keeps the PVCs
    whenScaled: Retain# scaling down keeps the PVCs
  # ④ How do I change it?
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate# or OnDelete
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 0# only ordinals >= partition get the new template
      maxUnavailable: 1# beta in 1.35; one Pod at a time
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10# ControllerRevisions kept for rollback
  # ⑤ What runs in each Pod?
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: orders-db
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 999# postgres group owns the EBS filesystem
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: orders-db
      initContainers:
        - name: init-role
          image: ghcr.io/jahez/postgres:16.4
          command: ["bash", "/scripts/init-role.sh"]
          env:
            - name: POD_ORDINAL
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.labels['apps.kubernetes.io/pod-index']
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: orders-db-secret
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: scripts
              mountPath: /scripts
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: ghcr.io/jahez/postgres:16.4
          args: ["-c", "wal_level=replica", "-c", "max_wal_senders=10", "-c", "hot_standby=on", "-c", "max_connections=300"]
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: orders-db-secret
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: initdb
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["pg_isready", "-U", "orders", "-h", "127.0.0.1"]
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["pg_isready", "-U", "orders", "-h", "127.0.0.1"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
            limits:
              memory: 2Gi
      volumes:
        - name: scripts
          configMap:
            name: orders-db-config-map
            items:
              - key: init-role.sh
                path: init-role.sh
